Name: Monster girls farm (with Voice replacer)
Author: Teratore
Description:
[center][font=Verdana][size=5][u][b]﻿Description[/b][/u][/size][/font][/center]So while playing stardew i was like "Why not turn it into monster girl farm?" and then i found some mods such as 
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/341]Monster girl livestock [/url]﻿from [b]monmsky [/b]
[url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/cute-monster-animals-girls.109815/]Cute monster girls [/url]﻿from [b]AnoNJG[/b] (child monster sprites and dog\cat replacer) 
And thanks to [b]igoutta [/b]for making content patcher version of Monster girl livestock mod

But after installing them i though that its weird that this cute girls keep making animal noises so i went and replaced them with a bit more fitting sounds.
Some of them might be a bit NSFW so keep that in mind[size=1] (i took them from H game afterall)  [/size]
[size=2]Also i recollored sheep,baby pig and baby cows to match their grown and child types.[/size]
[u]
[b][size=5]What this mod does?[/size][/b][/u]
-Replaces all barn and coop animals, and both type of pets with a cute monster girls. 
-Replaces all animal noises (Except rabbits and cat) to anime girl voices. 
-Also replaces sound when getting hit  

[u][b][size=5]Compability[/size][/b][/u]
Not compabile with any mod that changes game sounds since they all packed in one file.
Also any mods that replaces Barn or Coop animals as well as Dogs and Cats

[u][b][size=5]Installation[/size][/b]
[/u]-Install Content patcher and all it requirements
[b][i]Sprites[/i][/b]
-Put[b] [CP] MonsterGirl Animals[/b] in your [b]Stardew valley\Mod[/b] directory 
[b][i]Sounds[/i][/b]
-Go to your [b]Stardew valley\Content[/b] folder and backup [b]XACT[/b] folder
-Copy and past[b] Content[/b] folder from this mod to your [b]Stardew valley[/b] folder 
-Confirm replace everything. 
[center][size=5][b][u]Known issues[/u][/b][/size][/center]-Since it replaces Duck sound wich used when you press on logo on loading screen sometimes you can hear weird moan.
-Due to the way voices work they can sometimes sound weird. (they just change pitch from high to low) 
-Since sound of getting hit is same for both genders might sound weird when playin as male. 

[u][size=4][b]Plans
[/b][/size][/u]-Add voices to Dino and cat (I didnt change them since i use dog, and havent found dino yet so i dont know what sound he makes) 
-Probably will replace some voices if i find other that more fitting.
